response.explanation: The domain entity Subscription in src/domain/subscription.ts imports SystemClock from the outbound adapter layer on line 1. On line 4 it creates the clock itself (new SystemClock()), and isActive() on line 9 calls SystemClock.now(). The graph slice shows the same coupling: a CALLS edge to SystemClock.now and a FLOWS_TO edge to SystemClock. FF-S04 flags this because the dependency points the wrong way. A core file depends on a concrete adapter instead of an abstraction that the core owns. The domain is therefore tied to the real system time, cannot be tested with a controlled clock, and cannot be built or reasoned about without the adapter layer. ADR-0002 once allowed this import, but its status is "Superseded by ADR-0009". The accepted ADR-0009 forbids the core from importing SystemClock or any other adapter and requires a Clock port in src/domain, which the outbound adapter implements. This code has not been migrated to that decision.
